# Synthetic WFC fixtures

These five logical arrays are deterministic, project-authored test fixtures only. They are not owner-approved exemplar artwork, are never loaded by production code, and do not imply production acceptance. Four fixtures exercise 3, 6, 8, and 10 canonical colors; the fifth is a 10-color transition fixture used only for benchmark topology. Together they exercise N=2/N=3 transforms and periodic extraction.
